sentence_stem: I am sorry I did not reply sooner because
correct_completion: I was very busy this week.
full_sentence: I am sorry I did not reply sooner because I was very busy this week.
acceptable_variants: I had a lot of work this week.
I was on holiday for a few days.

options.text: I am happy to hear from you.
options.why_wrong: This is a positive reaction, but 'because' needs a clause that gives the reason for the late reply.

options.text: I was very busy this week.

options.why_wrong: This is a friendly comment, but it does not explain why the reply was late.
This is a suggestion for the future, not a reason for the delay.

grammar_focus: Clauses of reason with 'because' in an apology
explanation: After 'because', we need a full clause that gives the reason for the situation in the first part of the sentence. Learners should use a subject and a verb after the connector rather than a noun phrase or a suggestion.
translation: Lo siento no haber respondido antes porque estuve muy ocupado esta semana.
